evidence: Modifies src/torcontrol.cpp to change how Tor control port authentication tokens are sent, which falls directly under P2P's Tor integration.
rationale: Fixes an authentication failure where Tor control passwords containing backslashes get mangled or leave strings unterminated. The PR description notes that 'any password containing a backslash was mangled (or left the string unterminated)' because only double quotes were escaped.
